page.layout: One printed page. Full-width dedication heading at top (address lines, centred), then "Salutem." centred, then one text block of justified running text with a large woodcut initial V at left. One marginal note at right beside the line "lilio" (Cantic. 2. 2.). Small faint marginal notes at right lower down (partly illegible). Running head: none. Page number/signature at foot: "2" centred with a catchword-like mark "Ac vt" at right and a faint "s" mark at left, treated as signature/catchword area.

main_text.head: Amplis. sapientibus & prudentissimis viris, Reipub. Leydensis D.D. Prætori, Consulibus Scabinis Salutem.
main_text.p: VERE & eleganter, amplissimi & sapientes viri, à Sapienti viro ecclesia lilio Cantic. 2. 2. inter Spinas sito comparatur. Vt enim lilium illud spinarum aculeis pungitur, sed non exstinguitur: ita Dei ecclesia circumstantium aduersariorum machinis premi potest, sed non opprimi: quemadmodum perpetua omnium temporum experientia attestatur. Nam & princeps infidelium huius mundi Diabolus interdum leonina feritate, interdum serpentina calliditate, aduersus ecclesiam certat: & ministri illius, Christi ecclesiæque hostes coniurati, eandem partim aperta vi, partim operta fraude, frustra oppugnant.

page.notes: Faint show-through from the reverse page throughout. Right-margin notes near the middle and lower part are too faded to read and are not transcribed. The woodcut initial V is decorative. Dedication lines are set in mixed capitals and small capitals; "Reipub. Leydensis" is as printed.
